sources.name: StockCharts.com ChartSchool: Wyckoff Stock Analysis
sources.quote: Even though the broad market governs the general trend for all stocks, Wyckoff understood that certain groups lead the market and certain groups lag the market.

sources.name: StockCharts.com ChartSchool: Wyckoff Stock Analysis
sources.quote: First, single out a particular group or sector within the broader market that shows relative strength. Second, look for stocks within this group that are showing relative strength.

sources.name: StockCharts.com ChartSchool: Wyckoff Stock Analysis
sources.quote: This means buying stocks showing relative strength and avoiding stocks showing relative weakness.

sources.name: StockCharts.com ChartSchool: Wyckoff Stock Analysis
sources.quote: Groups that hold up when the market moves lower show relative strength. Groups that fail to rally when the market advances show relative weakness.
